summary: Quince Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that it received a Nasdaq notice on May 20, 2026, confirming compliance with Listing Rule 5450(b)(1)(A) based on stockholders' equity of $15.672 million, thereby closing a prior minimum market value deficiency. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation. No transaction, tender, activism, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. The filing simply notifies the market of regained listing compliance.
